# Heaven•Sent

> Vivid color & alt cut studio based in Bloomington, Indiana. Vivids, panels, ghost roots, blonding and shags by Addy Jewell, with a cut and style included in every color service. On North Walnut Street in Bloomington.

- Phone: (812) 554-0337
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer, Nashville
- Google rating: 5.0 from 16 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/heaven-sent/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/heaven-sent/book.html

## Services
- Vivid color: Magenta, violet, fire red, silver-blue, anything. Bleached out, saturated and finished with a cut and style.
- Panels, peekaboos & raccoon tails: A pop of color on your current hair: one panel, a few, fox tips or a full raccoon tail.
- Highlights & blonding: Bright, dimensional blonde: full and partial highlights, balayage and all-over bleach and tone.
- All-over color & upkeep: Rich all-over color, ghost roots, retouches and a gloss to bring your color back to life.
- Alternative cuts: Shags, curtain bangs and layers with movement, for every hair type. Men's and kids' cuts too.
- Color correction & care: A plan to fix color that went wrong, plus treatments that keep bleached hair soft and strong.

## About
Heaven•Sent is where Bloomington stylist Addy Jewell does her thing: vivid and artistic color, alternative haircuts and hairstyles. Her goal, in her words, is to give every client their dream hair while prioritizing hair health. You'll find her at 1000 N Walnut St, a bright, open salon with cream walls, honey wood floors, hanging plants and a giant black-and-gray swirl-face mural with red lips. Clients come in with big ideas and leave with exactly what they pictured. One drove three hours round trip and stayed almost eight for her dream hair. Another client's partner left saying he felt pretty. That's the whole idea.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you do vivid or fashion colors?
  A: That's Addy's specialty. Magenta, violet, red, blue, split dye, panels and full vivid transformations. Not sure your idea is possible? Book a free consultation and ask.
- Q: How long does a vivid appointment take?
  A: It depends on your starting point. A panel or gloss can be quick; a full bleach-out and vivid can take most of the day. One client stayed almost eight hours for her dream hair, and said no regrets.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Addy's GlossGenius booking page, or call or message (812) 554-0337. Every appointment is secured with a deposit that goes toward your service.
- Q: What's the cancellation policy?
  A: Cancel 48+ hours ahead and only the deposit is kept. Inside 48 hours there is a 50% charge, and inside 24 hours or a no-show is charged in full. Rescheduling is handled case by case.
- Q: Is a haircut included with color?
  A: Yes. A cut and style are included with every color service. Each color service includes a set number of color bowls; extra bowls are $10.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 1000 N Walnut St, Bloomington, IN 47404. Tuesday to Saturday 12 to 8 PM, Sunday 12 to 7 PM, closed Monday.
